evidence_status: Schema and generated software-audit contract only. Source-specific field inventories have not been reviewed, and no real materialization is cleared.

comparison_unit.field_segment: Each exporter emits one nonempty UTF-8 string per declared canonical slot. Every normalized slot is retained as a separate overlap unit.
comparison_unit.record_aggregate: The domain-separated ordered slot/value aggregate remains a record-level exact-deduplication unit.
comparison_unit.cross_field_rule: The lexical audit compares every eligible field segment against every field segment of every other retained record, including unlike field classes.
comparison_unit.empty_or_missing_rule: A missing, empty, unreviewed, or multiply mapped required field class blocks materialization.

field_classes.model-input: Text rendered to a trainable or evaluated model before it generates an output.
field_classes.training-target: Text used as an SFT target or otherwise made directly model-visible during optimization.
field_classes.protected-input: Sealed benchmark or evaluation prompt text that must be checked for overlap but withheld from training and selection.
field_classes.protected-target: Reference answer, verifier material, test, rubric, or other protected text that must be checked for leakage and access-isolated.

review_requirements: Inventory every textual field in the pinned source schema and classify whether it is model-visible, optimization-visible, or protected.
Bind the inventory to the exact source revision, exporter implementation, exporter version, and source-specific manual review record.
Demonstrate that every required class has exactly one or more named canonical slots and that no textual field is silently concatenated away.
Review structured-to-string flattening, message order, templates, tests, references, and alternate-answer fields before setting projection_status to reviewed_pass.
Freeze one field_inventory_sha256 and nonempty review_record per source declaration; partial approval is not inherited across revisions or roles.
limitations: This contract does not infer source schemas or approve the null field inventories committed here.
Field-complete lexical comparison is still not a semantic, privacy, legal, contamination, or human-subjects clearance.
The external exact-audit contract currently indexes record pairs; a segment-pair successor is required before a large multi-field artifact can pass.
Protected fields must be checked by an access-isolated process; listing their paths does not authorize selection or training code to read their bytes.
